svg.text: One desktop app, one background terminal service, four local doors, and ordinary Git worktrees.
One process per profile · SQLite WAL · DPAPI vault · no Kolux server
App code is trusted; browser pages are not.
Loopback only, bearer tokens in user files.
Agents run with your permissions; not a sandbox.
Update trust is one minisign key.
Solid lines are requests or control. Dashed lines are reports or events.
